                if ok_all and len(to_keep) > best_size:
                    best_pts = to_keep
                    best_size = len(to_keep)
                    if best_size >= 112:
                        break

        restarts += 1
        if restarts > 6:
            # limit number of restarts
            break

        # small delay to respect time budget (no sleeping)
        if time.time() - start_time > time_limit:
            break

    # Finalize: return best found as list of [x, y]
    return [list(p) for p in best_pts]
